doc: Unlinks a node from a doubly-linked intrusive list, clearing bit 0x4000 of its flags field. If the node has a prev pointer, it's a mid/tail-list unlink (prev->next = next, next->prev = prev). If prev is null, the node was the list head, so the global head pointer D_80081498 is updated to the node's next, and next->prev is cleared. Finally both next/prev pointers on the node are zeroed.

globals.name: D_80081498
globals.decl: extern S_8003FFF0 *D_80081498[4]; // global list head pointer for this node type; declared as an array (>8 bytes) so gcc emits %hi/%lo addressing matching the target, since the true size/type of this global is unknown from this function alone
